card.name: Linking words before level or state terms
card.fires_on: Small linking words (of, into, low, be, in, when, the) in technical or drug-label text, where the next word likely describes a level or state such as rising, falling, low or high.

modes.label: Prepositions before an effect or mode
modes.description: Words like of or into that come right before a noun for an effect or operating mode.
modes.example: will delay establishment<< of>> an antiplatelet effect by several days

modes.label: Low/high before a measure
modes.description: The adjective low or high just before a rate, binding or metabolism term.
modes.example: eliminated by the kidneys with a<< low>> plasma protein binding of approximately 35

modes.label: Verb helpers before a condition
modes.description: Words like be, when or the that lead into a condition or timing clause.
modes.example: is best performed<< when>> the anticoagulant effect of dab

card.writes: It suppresses words like rising and falling, so it likely holds back direction-of-change words at that spot.
card.plain: It fires on small connecting words just before a description of a level or state, and it discourages saying rising or falling next.
